definition_english: An angular north-south coordinate specifying the position of a point on Earth's surface relative to the equatorial plane, measured from 0 degrees at the Equator to 90 degrees north or south at the poles.
definition_hindi: पृथ्वी की सतह पर किसी बिंदु की विषुवत् वृत्त के सापेक्ष उत्तर या दक्षिण दिशा में कोणीय स्थिति, जिसे विषुवत् वृत्त पर 0 डिग्री से लेकर ध्रुवों पर 90 डिग्री उत्तर या दक्षिण तक मापा जाता है।

etymology.root: lātitūdō (breadth, width) from lātus (broad, wide; Old Latin stlātus), PIE *stele- (to spread)
etymology.semantic_development: Classical geographers termed the shorter north-south extent of the habitable world 'breadth', yielding the terrestrial north-south angular coordinate sense.

hindi.adjective_agreement: Takes masculine modifiers (उच्च अक्षांश, मानक अक्षांश); derived adjective अक्षांशीय is invariable
syntactic_patterns: एक डिग्री अक्षांश की रैखिक दूरी

usage_restrictions: Restricted to terrestrial geographic/geodetic positioning; must not be extended to figurative administrative or legal leeway (HAT-003-S3) to avoid cross-sense errors such as 'अक्षांश की अनुमति'.

linguistic_analysis.gender_asymmetry: अक्षांश is masculine (पुल्लिंग), whereas the cartographic compound अक्षांश रेखा is feminine (स्त्रीलिंग), requiring distinct verb and modifier agreement.
linguistic_analysis.derivational_mapping: English adjective 'latitudinal' maps to invariable Hindi adjective 'अक्षांशीय' (e.g., अक्षांशीय विस्तार).

conceptual_analysis.core_concept: North-south terrestrial angular coordinate measured from Earth's equatorial plane (0 to 90 degrees N/S).
conceptual_analysis.geodetic_note: Because Earth is an oblate spheroid (लघ्वक्ष गोलाभ), the linear ground distance of one degree of latitude increases slightly from the Equator towards the poles.
conceptual_analysis.neighbor_boundaries: Parallels of latitude remain parallel to the Equator, unlike meridians of longitude (देशांतर) which converge at the poles; distinct from celestial latitude (खगोलीय अक्षांश) and equatorial declination (दिक्पात).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both refer to north-south terrestrial positioning in geography and cartography.
pairwise_comparison.difference: अक्षांश (masculine) names the angular coordinate itself, whereas अक्षांश रेखा (feminine) names the imaginary line connecting points of equal latitude on a map or globe.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Not freely interchangeable; coordinate measurements require अक्षांश while drawn cartographic circles take अक्षांश रेखा.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both denote east-west circles of constant latitude on Earth's surface.
pairwise_comparison.difference: अक्षांश रेखा corresponds to 'line of latitude', whereas अक्षांश समानांतर explicitly translates 'parallel of latitude' in contrast to converging meridians.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Contextually interchangeable in cartography, though अक्षांश समानांतर is more precise for 'parallel of latitude'.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both refer to the same geographic coordinate.
pairwise_comparison.difference: अक्षांश is the formal Hindi scientific equivalent, whereas लैटिट्यूड is an English phonetic transliteration.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Not interchangeable in formal academic or official Hindi writing.
